title: Tatva 26 Festival Identity
description: A comprehensive visual identity system and event branding for the annual college fest. The identity bridges geometric architectural grids with dynamic generative wave patterns.
process: Explored custom typographic ligatures based on brutalist construction scaffolding. Developed responsive logos across digital signage, merchandise, wristbands, and motion title sequences.

title: NASA Design Compendium 2025
description: An 84-page architectural monograph and research publication documenting climate-resilient urban prototypes. Features custom typographic hierarchy, Swiss grid layouts, and gold foil stamped covers.
process: Constructed a 12-column baseline grid in InDesign to balance high-density technical diagrams, measured architectural drawings, and academic essays. Selected Cormorant Garamond and Neue Haas Grotesk for type pairing.

title: Tectonic Form: Architectural Poster Series
description: A curated print series celebrating seminal 20th-century brutalist structures across South Asia. Screen-printed in dual-tone silver and matte charcoal pigments.
process: Vectorized hand-drafted axonometric projections of iconic buildings, experimenting with exaggerated negative space and constructivist type layout.

title: Expresso Lit & Art Journal
description: Bi-annual student literary anthology featuring poetry, micro-fiction, and fine art prints. Designed with exposed smyth-sewn binding and tactile recycled kraft paper sleeves.
process: Curated paper stock weights and tactile page transitions. Established asymmetric editorial spreads that treat poetry and verse as visual forms on the page.

title: Studio Parametrica Brand System
description: Identity system for an experimental computational architecture studio. The logo mark responds dynamically to viewport aspect ratio and sound frequencies.
process: Scripted vector algorithms in Grasshopper to generate procedural mark iterations, which were then refined into a cohesive design system and brand book.

title: Urban Flow: Spatial Wayfinding App
description: Minimalist digital signage and mobile navigation UI designed to guide visitors across complex institutional campuses with high-contrast accessibility.
process: Conducted on-campus wayfinding user journey mapping. Built interactive Figma design system with WCAG AAA contrast compliance and tactile haptic cues.
